name: Setessa
description: The isolated, fiercely independent polis surrounded by concentric rings of forest, whose people venerate nature.

description_citations.text: "Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Setessan ambassador fails to reach an accord with King Athanas and hints they may take it up with his heir, Timoteus.
timeline.quote: We may take this up with your heir.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Athanas declares that Anax is his eldest, and the ambassador seems unimpressed by Anax.
timeline.quote: This is Anax, my eldest.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Athanas dismisses the ambassador as part of a council of cowards and vows to crush the Setessans if they come.
timeline.quote: But if they do, we will crush them.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: At six, Cilissa is brought to Setessa as an orphan and receives a vision of Karametra.
timeline.quote: A vision of Karametra hovered in the starfield of Nyx above Cilissa

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karametra's sparks create glowing pods whose warmth brings Cilissa memories of her parents' fall to Akroan attackers.
timeline.quote: Her father fell to the first wave of Akroan attackers.

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At nine, Cilissa spars with Thora and then Niketa, who tells her to be more aggressive.
timeline.quote: It was not enough to simply be the strongest or the fastest.

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At fourteen, Cilissa and Thora say farewell to Kelios on his peregrination, and Thora is furious with Cilissa.
timeline.quote: Thora was furious with Cilissa when Kelios left

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At eighteen, the Nyxborn attack Setessa in droves and Cilissa helps defend the city.
timeline.quote: the Nyxborn were all attacking Setessa in droves

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Nyxborn minotaur kills Delia, and a Nyxborn gorgon petrifies Thora and Natasa.
timeline.quote: she saw Thora and Natasa become pale statues of stone

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cilissa kills the gorgon with her axe and lures a minotaur into cleaving open Karametra's pod, dissolving all Nyxborn.
timeline.quote: All the Nyxborn slowly dissolved into nothingness.

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Months later, Cilissa welcomes a new group of orphaned children with Karametra's voice.
timeline.quote: She let her voice be infused by the presence of Karametra

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Raissa, pregnant with twins, consults the Sigiled Starfish and sees visions of the womb.
timeline.quote: Raissa had visited the briny tidal pool often as she carried the twins.

citation.text: "Raissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In her vision the boy crowds out and eclipses the girl; Raissa breaches the vision and afterward feels only one child within her.
timeline.quote: feeling only the presence of one child within her.

citation.text: "Raissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At eight months the starfish shows Raissa places beyond Theros that her child will visit.
timeline.quote: Other planes of existence her child would visit.

citation.text: "Raissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos is born, kicking and horned; the midwife curses him and leaves in a huff.
timeline.quote: when the midwife finally pulled him from her, he kicked at her.

citation.text: "Raissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Raissa decides not to abandon her son as most satyr women do, believing he is special and needs her.
timeline.quote: But Raissa looked down at the pink face of her boy and knew she could not.

citation.text: "Raissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Six years later Xenagos shoves a council member's son to his death from a rope bridge, so they are cast out of Setessa.
timeline.quote: He had caused them to be cast out of Setessa

citation.text: "Raissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos sets his mother's bed alight and hits her on the head with a stick, giggling.
timeline.quote: he struck her in the side of her head with his stick.

citation.text: "Raissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The vision ends with Xenagos laughing and holding a stick dripping ichor, the starfish impaled on it.
timeline.quote: At the end of the stick writhed the impaled gray body of the starfish.

citation.text: "Raissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The other gods call their champions from the Underworld and war breaks out; rifts to the Underworld release monsters and Polukranos besieges Setessa.
timeline.quote: The giant nyxborn hydra Polukranos laid siege to Setessa , which was defended by Haktos .

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth leads an army of heroes from Akros, Meletis and Setessa to break the siege; the victory celebration becomes the ritual that launches Xenagos into Nyx as a god.
timeline.quote: the victory celebration after the battle became the ultimate ritual to launch Xenagos into Nyx as a god.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mogis sends hordes of minotaurs against Akros, Meletis and Setessa.
timeline.quote: Mogis , the god of slaughter sends hordes of mortal and Nyxborn minotaurs against the human cities Akros , Meletis , and Setessa .

citation.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orphaned children stream into a forest clearing in Setessa, among them Cilissa, who forces herself not to cry.
timeline.quote: So many children.

citation.text: "Seasons in Setessa". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The woman names the children arkulli, little bears, and declares them Setessan; the stars form a bear.
timeline.quote: "Welcome, arkulli . From now on, you are Setessan.

citation.text: "Seasons in Setessa". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Raissa gives birth to her horned, kicking son, assisted by a midwife who thanks the gods.
timeline.quote: That anger gave her strength, which she used to finally expel him, howling, from her body.

citation.text: "Thank the Gods" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: During her pregnancy Raissa consults the starfish in a tidal pool, which shows her twins, then the boy crowding out the girl until only one child remains.
timeline.quote: feeling only the presence of one child within her.

citation.text: "Thank the Gods" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Raissa's flashback vision shows her son fully grown with horns, destined to be a king, with worlds beyond Theros spinning around him.
timeline.quote: Her son would be a king!

citation.text: "Thank the Gods" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Raissa decides not to abandon her child to Setessa as most satyr women would, believing he is special and needs her.
timeline.quote: This child was special, and he would need her to fulfill the destiny she had witnessed.

citation.text: "Thank the Gods" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Years later, Raissa escapes a burning house with her six-year-old son, who set her bed alight; they have been cast out of Setessa after he pushed a council member's son to his death.
timeline.quote: He had caused them to be cast out of Setessa when he shoved the son of one of the Karametra temple's ruling council to his death from a high rope bridge among the trees.

citation.text: "Thank the Gods" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Raissa, walking without destination, wonders whether she is punished for not paying tribute to the gods, and her son strikes her head with a stick.
timeline.quote: The boy struck her in the side of her head with his stick.

citation.text: "Thank the Gods" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Raissa returns with her son to the tidal pools and finds the starfish again.
timeline.quote: Together, Raissa and her son floated into the dream.

citation.text: "Thank the Gods" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: The vision ends with Raissa's son laughing, holding aloft his stick with the impaled body of the starfish on it.
timeline.quote: At the end of the stick writhed the impaled gray body of the starfish.

citation.text: "Thank the Gods" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Meletis blames Kedarick and declares support for the leonin mission to overthrow him; Akros and Setessa decline aid.
timeline.quote: Meletis formally declared its support for the Leonin mission to overthrow Kedarick

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karametra teaches people to live in harmony with nature, leading to the founding of Setessa.
timeline.quote: the god Karametra tried to teach people a new way of living in harmony with nature, leading to the founding of Setessa

citation.text: "Setessa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos drags Anikthea, a former council member, to the Underworld, where she becomes a demigod serving Setessa.
timeline.quote: Dragged to the Underworld by Erebos , she serves Setessa's interests as a demigod

citation.text: "Setessa", section "Notable Setessans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Setessan archer Nikaia becomes the first caryatid.
timeline.quote: a Setessan archer who became the first caryatid

citation.text: "Setessa", section "Notable Setessans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ancient Setessans carve a fortified stronghold into the mountains to guard the Cypress Gates.
timeline.quote: Long ago, ancient Setessans carved a fortified stronghold into the mountains to guard the pass.

citation.text: "Nessian Wood", section "Locations in the Nessian Wood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nylea transforms those she deems worthy into trees, the caryatids, who protect Setessa.
timeline.quote: the god Nylea honors those that she deems worthy by transforming them into trees

citation.text: "Plant", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mortals endure and thrive on Theros behind the walls of great poleis, each a bulwark against raging monsters.
timeline.quote: each city-state a bulwark against the raging monsters that roam the more savage places of Theros.

citation.text: "Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
